import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import re,html
L='/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/new-twenty-2026-10-31/token-treewidth-primary-qualification-claude-r1'
b=open(L+'/sources/hickingbotham-wood-2110.00721.html','rb').read()
for mark in [b'challenge-platform',b'cf-chl-',b'verify you are human',b'Incapsula',b'robot check']:
    print(mark, b.lower().find(mark.lower()))
t=b.decode('utf-8','replace')
t=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>|<style.*?</style>','',t,flags=re.S)
t=re.sub(r'<math[^>]*?alttext="([^"]*)"[^>]*>.*?</math>',lambda m:' $'+html.unescape(m.group(1))+'$ ',t,flags=re.S)
t=re.sub(r'<(/p|/div|/h\d|br|/li)[^>]*>','\n',t)
t=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',t)
t=html.unescape(t)
t=re.sub(r'[ \t]+',' ',t); t=re.sub(r'\n\s*\n+','\n',t)
open(L+'/review-work/hw.txt','w',encoding='utf-8').write(t)
print('LEN',len(t)); print(t[:1800])
for k in ['separation','Cartesian product','square','grid','treewidth of Cartesian']:
    print(k,len(re.findall(k,t)))
for m in re.finditer(r'no \$?\(?.{0,30}separation|\\square P_|P_\{n_',t):
    print(m.start(), t[max(0,m.start()-100):m.start()+160].replace('\n',' '))
    print('--')
